message:
♦️ **FLEX ULTIMATE V3.0.0 IS LIVE! (PREMIERE PRO)**

**1,596 new templates** that play on hover before you download, **search** across every tab, **Import MOGRT**, **SS To Premiere** and **Flex Studio 1.0.0** out of beta.

*(Install over your current version and restart Premiere Pro once.)*

♦️ **New: Assets tab**
* **1,596 templates** and 11 new tabs: Infographics, Match Cuts, Lower Thirds, Instagram Stories and more. Download only the group you open.
* **Search** every template in every tab.
* **Import MOGRT**: your own files get a My Templates tab and a rendered preview (needs After Effects and ffmpeg).
* A **SLOTS** mark shows which templates take your own images or video.
* Tabs stay loaded, so going back to one is quick. Tabs in a sidebar or along the top, your choice.

♦️ **New: SS To Premiere** (FX & ADV RIGS)
* A screenshot becomes an animated sequence.

♦️ **Changed**
* **Organize Project** leaves your own bins and imported folders alone by default.
* **Retakes** moves to Gemini 3.5 Transcribe once (cloud, uploads the clip's audio, uses Flex AI credits). Pick another engine any time.

♦️ **Flex Studio 1.0.0**
* Out of beta. Much faster **Object Brush**, **SAM 3** (16 GB RAM or more), a Lumetri-style **ADJUSTMENT** tab, and a saved grade lands on your clip by itself.
* Grades need the **Flex STUDIO effect 1.1.0**: install it from FX & ADV RIGS > Flex Studio.

♦️ **Fixed**
* **Smart Synchronise** now syncs two devices recording apart in a room.
* The location card asking again on later launches, and the old licence box showing on a slow launch.
